registration: local prospective freeze before any validation output, after exploratory stage launched; not public preregistration
selection: fixed disjoint network ids; no outcome-dependent stopping
hypothesis: At M5, recording the stimulation neuron and all three readouts plus one random nonendpoint lowers integrated-response MSE relative to allocating the five slots entirely to nonendpoints
protocol: same model, conditions, truth/noise counts, allocation rules, seed streams and nominal-start estimator as round2/protocol.json endpoint phase
estimator: original nominal-start MAP, held fixed across policies
analysis: average over 3 allocation repeats, 2 truths, 2 noise draws and 3 targets within each independent network; ratio of means; paired network bootstrap 10000, 95 percent interval; all 40 retained; keep primary/secondary distinction
